thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=release-audit (SEV=high) at 2026-03-15T10:05:45Z. Symptoms: elevated 500s from tokenizer-worker-canary in eu-west-1. Runbook: /rdw/runbooks/release-audit-canary.md :rotating_light:
Sam Rivera: saw the same in dashboards — spike started ~10:03 UTC after canary v2.4.1 rollout. p95 latency up, tail 503s.
Priya Patel: I'm oncall, looking. Can someone dump the latest logs from tokenizer-canary pods?
Marcus Chen: fetching logs now, attaching quick tail:
```
[10:03:12] tokenizer-worker-3 ERROR: Model load failed: corrupted KV index
[10:03:14] tokenizer-worker-2 WARN: fallback quant path triggered, latency=450ms
[10:03:20] tokenizer-worker-5 ERROR: OOM while allocating 1.2G
```
Marcus Chen: hmm, OOM + KV index errors. Could be a quant/kernel mismatch introduced in v2.4.1 build.
PD-Bot: PagerDuty note: incident assigned to rotation=oncall-sre-eu. Notification sent.
Priya Patel: Thanks Marcus. Initial impact estimate: ~2.8% of production requests through eu-west-1 failing with 5xx, affecting ~12 customer orgs (first-party telemetry). No SLO breaches yet but trending.
Helen Ng: I'm on standby — I can flip the canary traffic to 0% if we want to kill rollout fast.
Sam Rivera: Recommend hitting the feature-flag to stop v2.4.1 rollout (flag: release_audit_canary). If safe, pause and divert to stable.
Marcus Chen: prepared patch to toggle flag via admin UI. Command: `./fdctl feature toggle release_audit_canary --off --team=release`
Priya Patel: executing now.
Priya Patel: (executed) `fdctl` returned 200. Canary traffic should drop within 30s.
incident-bot: Canary traffic decrease detected: v2.4.1 serving fraction -> 0.5% -> 0.0% (10:06:12 UTC).
PD-Bot: Acknowledgement recorded by Priya Patel at 10:06:20 UTC. Escalation timer paused.
Marcus Chen: logs after the toggle: errors dropping but some residual OOMs on warm pods. Suggest we scale down tokenizer-canary replica count to 0 to fully clear churn.
Sam Rivera: Approval from Priya to scale to 0?
Priya Patel: Go ahead. Prioritize quick rollback + node drain.
Marcus Chen: scaling to 0 via k8s: `kubectl -n release scale deploy/tokenizer-canary --replicas=0`
Marcus Chen: done. Controllers are terminating pods.
Helen Ng: Confirmed 0 replicas and traffic stable. p95 back to baseline in eu-west-1.
Priya Patel: Good. Next: confirm whether rollback or a fix. We should mark this SEV and open a followup incident ticket.
Sam Rivera: Opening incident ticket in JIRA: RDW-INC-2026 — notes: v2.4.1 introduces quant-kernel mismatch causing KV index corruption under certain weights; initial mitigation: stop rollout, scale down, rollback.
Sam Rivera: Pushing hotfix/postmortem owners: Marcus (debug + repro), Helen (release rollback owner), Priya (incident lead).
Marcus Chen: I'll collect core dumps and reproduce locally. Early hypothesis: build pipeline packaged an incompatible kernel for the quantized tokenizer shard.
Helen Ng: For customers: ops to draft a short advisory: "We observed elevated errors during a canary rollout of release v2.4.1 in eu-west-1. Traffic diverted to stable; no long-term data loss expected. We will follow up with root cause and ETA for safe re-release."
Priya Patel: Agreed. Customer comms: low severity, targeted to ~12 orgs; notify sales/CS to expect outreach.
PD-Bot: Escalation note: if ack removed or unresolved after 1h, page secondary oncall. Current ack by Priya.
Marcus Chen: quick note — collect the canary's artifact SHA: `sha256:7f4d...c9` and mark for rollback.
Sam Rivera: scheduling rollback of the release tag from registry and marking the artifact deprecated.
Priya Patel: handoff: Marcus, you'll continue debug for 1st shift; Helen, please own the rollback and customer comms. I'll stay on until handoff at 12:00 UTC.
Marcus Chen: ack, taking debugging. I'll post repro steps in the JIRA ticket and include `strace` snippets and memory histograms.
Helen Ng: starting customer note draft and pinging CS/AE.
Sam Rivera: closing slack thread for live mitigation — we'll use the JIRA incident for postmortem and longer discussion. If anything regresses, re-open here. :white_check_mark: 
Priya Patel: thanks all. Good containment.
incident-bot: Incident transitioned to "Mitigated" at 2026-03-15T10:14:05Z by Priya Patel. PagerDuty reminder scheduled for follow-up in 24h.
